items.title: Developer docs
items.text:
The developer site for this repo: for the people who build and run it, how it works and why. The agents' own docs are in agent_docs/.

Replace this stub with the repo's own pages, and add each page to nav in zensical.toml.

items.title: Decisions
items.text: To show an ADR here, add a symlink, dev_docs/adr/<file>.md to ../../agent_docs/adr/<file>.md, and a line in zensical.toml's nav, under a Decisions section. Zensical follows a symlinked file, not a symlinked directory. A link inside an ADR resolves from dev_docs/adr/, not agent_docs/adr/, so it must point at a file under dev_docs/ or be an absolute GitHub URL: --strict fails on a relative link such as ../agents/workflow.md.

items.title: Serve it
items.text:
uvx zensical@0.0.67 serve

serve (and build) write the site to site_dir (site/). The workflow doesn't touch your .gitignore, so add site/ to it. A new repo's scripts/check.sh runs build --strict in its full gate; --fast never builds. A repo that already had its own check.sh keeps it, so add this line to its full branch, outside --fast:

[ ! -f zensical.toml ] || uvx zensical@0.0.67 build --strict
